title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Targeted response to essential needs of affected communities in Kachin State and Southeast Myanmar programme is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include rehabilitate gender and disability inclusive wash infrastructure, train and support WASH committees, support operation and maintenance costs, conduct Hygiene promotion so, the most vulnerable are utilising humanitarian assistance that is principled, timely, of high quality and in line with their needs and priorities. Programmes are in partnership with Serve the World, KDG and EcoDev (ALARM). ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- Improve access to WASH and nutrition knowledge- ensure that women and girls benefit equally with men from the activity to compensate for past discrimination
